title: KV Cache Explained: The Complete Guide to KV Cache in LLM Inference
author: Luv Bansal
summary: KV cache stores attention data in large language models to avoid recomputing tokens and is crucial for efficient inference. Over time, KV cache management evolved from simple fixed allocation to advanced techniques like paging, distributed caching, and unified hybrid memory systems. These improvements enable faster, scalable, and more memory-efficient AI model deployment in production.
